task: Separate org echo uncertainty from size failure and accelerate safe upward probing
resume_instruction: Owner live run proves exact echoes for 4879/2098, 4887/2100 and 4940/1161 byte org replies, while 644-byte #online visibly delivered to org but Manager missed its self-echo and retried/spammed. Fix: missing echo only drives downshift/retry for a near-current-budget growth probe; small misses are detector uncertainty only. Track proven-safe and failed page budgets plus max confirmed bytes in status. Upward probes use ~10% rounded-to-50 (min250); once a failed budget exists, narrow between proven-safe and failed. Preserve 5200 default, exact positive echo proof and 3s retry grace for genuine frontier probes.
